newsitem.title: HUNGARY: BCHEM APPEALS LOWERED CUSTOMS, TAX CHARGES.
newsitem.headline: BCHEM APPEALS LOWERED CUSTOMS, TAX CHARGES.

text.p: Hungarian chemicals company BorsodChem Rt said on Tuesday it would appeal against customs and tax charges which were lowered to 231.4 million forints from 322 million after BorsodChem's first appeal.
BorsodChem appealed in April against customs and tax charges levied on the lease of rail carriages totalling 322 million.
The company said earlier the lease of rail carriages had been exempt from customs in the period when BorsodChem leased them.
